# apple-ads_negative_keyword (Resource)

Manages an Apple Ads negative keyword at either campaign or ad-group scope.

Exactly one of `campaign_id` or `ad_group_id` must be set. Campaign-scoped and ad-group-scoped negatives use different Apple Ads endpoints under the hood; this resource branches internally.

**Immutable:** `campaign_id`, `ad_group_id`, `text`, `match_type` — changing these returns an error (no `RequiresReplace`).

**Mutable:** `status` (`ACTIVE` / `PAUSED`).

**Computed:** `id`, `modification_time`. When only `ad_group_id` is set, `campaign_id` is resolved and stored as computed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Campaign-scoped and ad-group-scoped negatives share one resource type.
# Exactly one of campaign_id or ad_group_id must be set.

resource "apple-ads_negative_keyword" "campaign_free" {
  campaign_id = apple-ads_campaign.example.id
  text        = "free"
  match_type  = "EXACT"
  status      = "ACTIVE"
}

resource "apple-ads_negative_keyword" "adgroup_cheap" {
  ad_group_id = apple-ads_ad_group.main.id
  text        = "cheap"
  match_type  = "BROAD"
  status      = "ACTIVE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `match_type` (String) EXACT or BROAD (immutable).
- `text` (String) Negative keyword text (immutable).

### Optional

- `ad_group_id` (String) Ad group id for ad-group-scoped negatives (immutable). Mutually exclusive with configuring `campaign_id`.
- `campaign_id` (String) Campaign id for campaign-scoped negatives (immutable). Also computed for ad-group-scoped negatives.
- `status` (String) ACTIVE or PAUSED (mutable).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Negative keyword identifier.
- `modification_time` (String) Last modification timestamp.
